name: Entity data
description: Allows to store custom data per entity.
project_description: Entity data provides a simple developer API to store arbitrary custom data per content entity, similar to core's user.data service but not restricted to users. A single service (entity.data) offers get()/set()/delete() methods that persist scalar values or serialized arrays/objects in a dedicated entity_data database table keyed by module, entity type, entity id and a name. Data is automatically removed when its entity is deleted, and a Views field handler exposes stored values. An admin settings form controls which PHP classes may be unserialized.
